title: Synthesis Can Re-Enter RESEARCH
summary: Establishes that SYNTHESIS is usually terminal but can re-enter RESEARCH when structural experimentation (ADR-028) surfaces an incoherence the pipeline has not addressed, the writer cannot explain the material to the identified audience, or the framing conversation surfaces an unaddressed question. Re-entry is the writer's decision, not the agent's recommendation, and must be scoped narrowly to a specific research question at a specific scope, with the finding recorded in the research log before the pipeline loops back.
workflow_point: SYNTHESIS, after framing, conditional re-entry to RESEARCH
mechanism: conditional writer-triggered re-entry loop from SYNTHESIS back to RESEARCH, narrowly scoped

links.note: relaxes ADR-012's 'terminal phase' designation for synthesis to 'usually terminal' — synthesis remains optional and post-build but may loop back to RESEARCH when warranted.
structural experiments (ADR-028) are the primary mechanism that surfaces the incoherence triggering re-entry.
